name: How to use the CLV calculator

step.name: Enter your average order value
step.text: Input the average amount a customer spends in a single purchase, total revenue divided by total orders.

step.name: Enter your purchase frequency
step.text: Input how many orders the average customer places in a year, orders divided by unique customers.

step.name: Enter your gross margin
step.text: Input the percentage left after cost of goods sold, shipping and payment fees.

step.name: Enter your annual retention rate
step.text: Input the share of customers still buying a year later. The calculator converts it into an average customer lifespan.

step.name: Add your acquisition cost
step.text: Optional. Adding your CAC unlocks the CLV:CAC ratio, the payback period and the maximum CAC you can afford.
